notes.title: Third update - v1.03
notes.content:
We had the game proofread by two native English speakers and corrected everything. Although there were no major grammar or spelling mistakes before, it should now sound more natural. In the process, we also fixed a few minor typos.

We are committed to updating and improving the game, so if you happen to play and spot any language issues, please let us know, and we will address them immediately. Thank you!

notes.title: Second update - v1.02
notes.content:
- Two small typos.
- Mac version. (First time on Mac, we might need to change something)
- One bug fixed on case 1. Now a puzzle can be solved in another way.

notes.title: First update - v1.01
notes.content:
First users have reported, and it has been fixed in this release:
- Small typos
- One non blocking bug on Case 3
- One weird bug on Case 3 that can happen under unlikely circumstances!
